prior_property_statements.LS07.P1:
The system SHALL choose the earliest eligible upcoming launch from the accepted
provider schedule using stable launch identifiers. It SHALL exclude cancelled
or confirmed completed entries, preserve uncertain timing explicitly, and not
treat a locally elapsed timestamp as confirmation that a launch occurred. Ordering preserves exact/date/window/source-coarse/unknown facts: known lower bounds and supplied UTC date boundaries intersect; a sole upper bound is used when no lower bound exists, with nominal source NET as an ordering anchor when no date/window is supplied. Wholly unknown timing remains eligible after sortable candidates; stable namespace/value breaks ties. Missing mappings and unfamiliar IDs cannot filter launches. Ordering does not claim no uncertain launch could occur earlier. Source statuses6/9 remain STARTED, excluded from upcoming selection without becoming COMPLETED.
prior_property_statements.LS09.P1: Subtract current UTC from exact or validated nominal-minute target on each redraw and wake; display accumulating-hours HH:mm:ss, missing targets --:--:-- and zero 00:00:00 without claiming liftoff. Keep source precision unchanged. Provider precision adaptation admits exact UTC only for whole-second Second0/SEC; raw nominal NET, source precision and supplied windows survive minute/hour/day/future/missing precision with no invented UTC date or bounds. Source started6/9 never becomes completed. Actual compiled active/sparse snapshots use the same format and current-clock arithmetic. Physical sleep, phone and Store qualification remain separate.

substitute for completing the known-model artwork acceptance gate.
